scope: Historical single-environment stepping comparison; no camera rendering, learner update, or SRAM/MDP2 combined run. Extracted from recorded JSONL, not rounded report tables.
statistic: For each run, free RTF is median of three 500-step windows with one CUDA synchronization at each window end. Table takes median across those run medians. RTF=simulated seconds/wall seconds; ratios are between different task frontends on separate trajectories. Synced values are median across per-run inverse mean step latencies.
limitations: No continuous foreign-GPU-process monitor; historical startup/end host samples only.
One GPU, one environment, one seed, zero actions; no confidence intervals, camera throughput, learner throughput or convergence inference.
MDP2 task is separate state-observation registration; this is not a demonstrated trajectory-parity ablation.
Harness frontend=torch denotes generic frontend selection; MDP2RLEnv uses its own Backend.WARP default and capture=True.
Do not multiply these environment ratios by independently measured SRAM learner ratios.
